verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a JMAP API with API tokens and standard OAuth 2.0/Bearer auth, so a custom agent can query, fetch, and send mail in one HTTP request. That gives the 'my own agent' path a real documented connection, but there is no evidence of a turnkey Claude or ChatGPT connector or MCP server. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404. Missing for 10: an official Claude/ChatGPT connector or MCP server, explicit documentation of draft creation and triage actions (move/flag/label) via the API, agent-oriented docs such as llms.txt, and independent hands-on reports of agents running email end to end.
